examples.en: She likes to flex her fingers before playing the piano.
examples.zh: 弹钢琴前她喜欢活动一下手指。

examples.en: He began his speech with a famous quotation from Shakespeare.
examples.zh: 他用莎士比亚的一句名言开始了演讲。

examples.en: The teacher tried to infuse new energy into the class.
examples.zh: 老师努力为这个班级注入新的活力。

examples.en: Every autumn we rake the dead leaves from the garden.
examples.zh: 每到秋天我们都会把花园里的枯叶耙起来。

examples.en: Water began to trickle slowly down the old wall.
examples.zh: 水开始顺着旧墙慢慢地流下来。

examples.en: Please help me inflate the balloons for the party.
examples.zh: 请帮我把派对用的气球充气。

examples.en: We roasted some chestnuts over the fire last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们在火上烤了一些栗子。

examples.en: It was a cold and windy day at the beach.
examples.zh: 那天海滩上又冷又刮风。

examples.en: These perennial flowers come back every spring.
examples.zh: 这些多年生的花每年春天都会重新开放。

examples.en: Our work schedules overlap on Monday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我们的工作时间在周一下午有重叠。

examples.en: A healthy diet may improve your longevity.
examples.zh: 健康的饮食也许能延长你的寿命。

examples.en: She added fresh cilantro to the noodle soup.
examples.zh: 她往面汤里加了新鲜的芫荽叶。

examples.en: The dog handler taught the puppy to sit quietly.
examples.zh: 训犬员教这只小狗安静地坐下。

examples.en: He sat by the window to muse about his future.
examples.zh: 他坐在窗边沉思着自己的未来。

examples.en: This old phone is now completely obsolete.
examples.zh: 这部旧手机现在已经完全过时了。

examples.en: The police soon found the real culprit.
examples.zh: 警方很快找到了真正的罪犯。

examples.en: The small shop went bankrupt after the fire.
examples.zh: 那家小店在火灾后破产了。

examples.en: His kindness showed the true greatness of his character.
examples.zh: 他的善良展现了他品格的真正伟大。

examples.en: The scientists noticed a strange anomaly in the data.
examples.zh: 科学家们注意到数据中有一个奇怪的异常。

examples.en: This is a cheaper variant of the same product.
examples.zh: 这是同一产品的一个更便宜的版本。

examples.en: The puzzle was intellectually challenging but fun.
examples.zh: 这个谜题在智力上很有挑战性，但很有趣。

examples.en: The mistake was small and quite insignificant.
examples.zh: 这个错误很小，而且无关紧要。

examples.en: The media mogul owns several large newspapers.
examples.zh: 这位媒体大亨拥有好几家大报社。

examples.en: The little baby began to wail in the night.
examples.zh: 小宝宝在夜里开始哀哀地哭起来。

examples.en: A night watcher stayed by the sick man's bed.
examples.zh: 一名守夜人守在病人的床边。

examples.en: The fast car tried to overtake the slow truck.
examples.zh: 那辆快车试图超过慢速的卡车。

examples.en: They feel a strong kinship because of their shared blood.
examples.zh: 因为有血缘关系，他们感到很深的亲情。

examples.en: The children behaved wonderfully at the dinner.
examples.zh: 孩子们在晚宴上表现得非常好。

examples.en: Many fans are waiting for the movie's sequel.
examples.zh: 许多影迷都在等这部电影的续集。

examples.en: I made a fruit smoothie in the blender.
examples.zh: 我用搅拌机做了一杯水果奶昔。

examples.en: Please zip up your jacket; it's getting cold.
examples.zh: 请把夹克的拉链拉上，天变冷了。

examples.en: The two companies settled their dispute through arbitration.
examples.zh: 两家公司通过仲裁解决了争端。

examples.en: The excavation of the old city took many years.
examples.zh: 那座古城的发掘工作花了许多年。

examples.en: The children slept on the top bunk of the bed.
examples.zh: 孩子们睡在床的上铺。

examples.en: His shirt was sweaty after the long run.
examples.zh: 长跑之后他的衬衫汗湿了。

examples.en: She became a surrogate mother for the lonely child.
examples.zh: 她成了那个孤独孩子的代理母亲。

examples.en: The two artists jointly created this beautiful painting.
examples.zh: 这两位艺术家共同创作了这幅美丽的画。

examples.en: Scientists studied the causal link between smoking and disease.
examples.zh: 科学家研究了吸烟与疾病之间的因果关系。

examples.en: The greedy boy ate all the cookies himself.
examples.zh: 那个贪吃的男孩把所有饼干都自己吃光了。

examples.en: Workers tried to salvage goods from the sunken ship.
examples.zh: 工人们试图从沉船中打捞货物。

examples.en: She kept a lamp on her bedside table.
examples.zh: 她在床头柜上放了一盏灯。

examples.en: The shepherd led his sheep across the green hills.
examples.zh: 牧羊人领着他的羊群越过青翠的山丘。

examples.en: The teacher gave an introductory lesson on history.
examples.zh: 老师上了一节历史的入门课。

examples.en: We have a yearly meeting every December.
examples.zh: 我们每年十二月都开一次年度会议。

examples.en: The court ordered punitive damages against the company.
examples.zh: 法院判决公司支付惩罚性赔偿金。

examples.en: The team brought together people with disparate skills.
examples.zh: 这个团队聚集了拥有各种不同技能的人。

examples.en: Grandma is famous for her wonderful storytelling.
examples.zh: 奶奶因为讲故事讲得精彩而出名。

examples.en: The design showed great sophistication and skill.
examples.zh: 这个设计展现出很高的复杂程度和技巧。

examples.en: For my entree, I chose the grilled chicken.
examples.zh: 我的主菜选了烤鸡。

examples.en: He told a funny anecdote about his childhood.
examples.zh: 他讲了一个关于他童年的有趣轶事。

examples.en: The manager was fired for serious misconduct.
examples.zh: 那位经理因严重的不当行为被解雇了。

examples.en: Admittedly, I made a mistake on the test.
examples.zh: 诚然，我在考试中犯了一个错误。

examples.en: Farmers in this area grow corn and soybean.
examples.zh: 这个地区的农民种植玉米和大豆。

examples.en: The frail old man walked slowly with a stick.
examples.zh: 那个虚弱的老人拄着拐杖慢慢走着。

examples.en: The unfair dismissal made the worker very angry.
examples.zh: 这次不公正的解雇让那名工人非常愤怒。

examples.en: Taxes are always a contentious topic in elections.
examples.zh: 税收在选举中总是个引起争议的话题。

examples.en: My little sister is a great helper in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我妹妹在厨房里是个得力的帮手。

examples.en: He built the shelves from cheap plywood.
examples.zh: 他用便宜的胶合板做了这些架子。

examples.en: The boy learned to play the trumpet at school.
examples.zh: 那个男孩在学校学会了吹小号。

examples.en: She developed a red rash on her arms.
examples.zh: 她的手臂上长出了红色的皮疹。

examples.en: This song is universally loved around the world.
examples.zh: 这首歌在世界各地都深受喜爱。

examples.en: The fans asked the singer for his autograph.
examples.zh: 粉丝们请那位歌手签名。

examples.en: The store sells sports apparel for children.
examples.zh: 这家店出售儿童的运动服装。

examples.en: She helped orchestrate the music for the school play.
examples.zh: 她帮忙为学校话剧编配了管弦乐。

examples.en: The hotel serves a simple continental breakfast.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆供应简单的欧陆式早餐。

examples.en: The students listened intently to the teacher.
examples.zh: 学生们专心地听着老师讲课。

examples.en: He practiced daily to hone his cooking skills.
examples.zh: 他每天练习以磨练自己的厨艺。

examples.en: We heard a loud gunshot in the distance.
examples.zh: 我们听到远处传来一声响亮的枪声。

examples.en: The mother held her tiny babe close.
examples.zh: 母亲把她小小的婴儿紧紧抱在怀里。

examples.en: In this sentence, "run" is the main verb.
examples.zh: 在这个句子里，"run"是主要动词。

examples.en: A good map is indispensable when you travel.
examples.zh: 旅行时一张好地图是不可缺少的。

examples.en: Traffic congestion makes the morning drive very slow.
examples.zh: 交通拥堵让早上的开车变得很慢。

examples.en: The hungry people rose in revolt against the king.
examples.zh: 饥饿的人民起来反抗国王。

examples.en: She used a blue dye to color the cloth.
examples.zh: 她用蓝色染料给布料上色。

examples.en: The storm could sever the power lines to town.
examples.zh: 暴风雨可能会切断通往镇上的电线。

examples.en: The nurse gave me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
examples.zh: 护士给了我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。

examples.en: He fastened the belt with a silver buckle.
examples.zh: 他用一个银色的扣子系上了皮带。

examples.en: There isn't enough clearance for the truck under the bridge.
examples.zh: 桥下的空间不够让卡车通过。

examples.en: On cold nights I love a warm cup of cocoa.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚我喜欢喝一杯温热的可可。

examples.en: They tried to discredit him with false rumors.
examples.zh: 他们试图用假谣言来败坏他的名声。

examples.en: The family returned to their ancestral home.
examples.zh: 这家人回到了他们祖传的老宅。

examples.en: I had a warm bun and some tea for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了一个热乎乎的小面包和一些茶。

examples.en: The crowd went "ooh" when the fireworks began.
examples.zh: 烟花开始时，人群发出"哦"的赞叹声。

examples.en: There was a procedural error during the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议中出现了一个程序上的错误。

examples.en: The factory must not pollute the groundwater.
examples.zh: 这家工厂绝不能污染地下水。

examples.en: A freak storm destroyed the small village.
examples.zh: 一场反常的暴风雨摧毁了那个小村庄。

examples.en: The report must be accurate and factual.
examples.zh: 这份报告必须准确且符合事实。

examples.en: The soldiers stood up to salute their general.
examples.zh: 士兵们起立向他们的将军敬礼。

examples.en: A green fern grew quietly in the shady corner.
examples.zh: 一株绿色的蕨类植物静静地长在阴凉的角落里。

examples.en: An old inscription was carved on the stone gate.
examples.zh: 石门上刻着一段古老的铭文。

examples.en: The table is made of strong hardwood.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是用坚固的硬木做的。

examples.en: Oranges and lemons are popular citrus fruits.
examples.zh: 橙子和柠檬都是很受欢迎的柑橘类水果。

examples.en: The museum has a large oriental art collection.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量的东方艺术品。

examples.en: A swarm of bees flew over the garden.
examples.zh: 一群蜜蜂飞过花园。

examples.en: Her stepfather taught her how to ride a bike.
examples.zh: 她的继父教她怎么骑自行车。

examples.en: The new action movie became a summer blockbuster.
examples.zh: 这部新的动作片成了夏季的大片。

examples.en: She poured some juice as a mixer for the drink.
examples.zh: 她倒了一些果汁作为这杯酒的调和饮料。

examples.en: Fishermen study the tidal patterns of the bay.
examples.zh: 渔民们研究海湾的潮汐规律。

examples.en: She added a handful of raisins to the bread.
examples.zh: 她往面包里加了一把葡萄干。

examples.en: Doctors worried about the deterioration of his health.
examples.zh: 医生们担心他健康状况的恶化。

examples.en: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of pollution.
examples.zh: 植树有助于减轻污染的影响。

examples.en: Her diary chronicled the family's daily life.
examples.zh: 她的日记记录了这个家庭的日常生活。

examples.en: There was a short interruption during the show.
examples.zh: 演出中途有过短暂的中断。

examples.en: There was growing unrest among the workers.
examples.zh: 工人们之间的不安情绪日益增长。

examples.en: The soft music helped to soothe the crying baby.
examples.zh: 轻柔的音乐帮助安抚了哭闹的婴儿。

examples.en: Science grows through careful experimentation.
examples.zh: 科学通过细致的实验而发展。

examples.en: The necklace has a tiny gold clasp.
examples.zh: 这条项链有一个小小的金扣子。

examples.en: A fallen tree was an obstruction on the road.
examples.zh: 一棵倒下的树成了路上的障碍物。

examples.en: A truck came to tow our broken car away.
examples.zh: 一辆卡车来把我们抛锚的汽车拖走了。

examples.en: She began to blush when everyone praised her.
examples.zh: 大家夸奖她时，她开始脸红了。

examples.en: I found a letter waiting in my mailbox.
examples.zh: 我发现邮箱里有一封等待我的信。

examples.en: From this vantage point we can see the whole valley.
examples.zh: 从这个有利位置我们能看到整个山谷。

examples.en: Old buildings sometimes contain dangerous asbestos.
examples.zh: 老建筑里有时含有危险的石棉。

examples.en: The dress needs a small alteration to fit better.
examples.zh: 这条裙子需要稍作改动才能更合身。

examples.en: Some grit got into my shoe during the walk.
examples.zh: 散步时有些砂砾跑进了我的鞋里。

examples.en: The small town sits on a narrow peninsula.
examples.zh: 这个小镇坐落在一个狭窄的半岛上。

examples.en: The child jumped happily into the muddy puddle.
examples.zh: 孩子开心地跳进泥泞的水坑里。

examples.en: After college he learned to fend for himself.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后他学会了自己照顾自己。

examples.en: She closed the shutter to keep out the sun.
examples.zh: 她关上百叶窗以挡住阳光。

examples.en: Green ivy climbed all over the old stone wall.
examples.zh: 绿色的常春藤爬满了古老的石墙。

examples.en: The visionary leader dreamed of a better city.
examples.zh: 这位有远见的领袖梦想着一个更美好的城市。

examples.en: The painting is full of religious symbolism.
examples.zh: 这幅画充满了宗教象征意义。

examples.en: It is doubtful whether he will come tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他明天是否会来还很难说。

examples.en: She seemed to despise people who lie.
examples.zh: 她似乎很鄙视那些说谎的人。

examples.en: To my dismay, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 令我沮丧的是，火车已经开走了。

examples.en: We had an enjoyable afternoon at the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园度过了一个愉快的下午。

examples.en: The dog barked loudly at the intruder.
examples.zh: 那只狗对着入侵者大声吠叫。

examples.en: The singing duo performed at the school concert.
examples.zh: 这个二人组合在学校音乐会上演出。

examples.en: Scientists made a clone of the sheep.
examples.zh: 科学家克隆了那只羊。

examples.en: The children spread jelly on their toast.
examples.zh: 孩子们在烤面包上抹了果冻。

examples.en: Young players try to emulate their favorite stars.
examples.zh: 年轻球员努力效仿他们最喜欢的明星。

examples.en: The king wore his ceremonial robes at the event.
examples.zh: 国王在仪式上穿着他的礼袍。

examples.en: Drinking too much water filled his bladder quickly.
examples.zh: 喝太多水使他的膀胱很快就胀满了。

examples.en: Everyone sang the refrain of the happy song.
examples.zh: 大家一起唱起这首欢快歌曲的副歌。

examples.en: She left her dinner untouched on the plate.
examples.zh: 她把晚饭原封不动地留在盘子里。

examples.en: They held a lavish wedding in a grand hotel.
examples.zh: 他们在一家豪华酒店举办了奢华的婚礼。

examples.en: The guests danced all night in the ballroom.
examples.zh: 客人们在舞厅里跳了一整夜舞。

examples.en: He hurt his knuckle when he hit the wall.
examples.zh: 他打到墙上时弄伤了指关节。

examples.en: Doctors must protect the confidentiality of patients.
examples.zh: 医生必须保护病人的隐私信息。

examples.en: The museum held a retrospective of her early work.
examples.zh: 博物馆举办了她早期作品的回顾展。

examples.en: Every pilgrim walked the long road to the temple.
examples.zh: 每一位朝圣者都走过通往寺庙的漫长道路。

examples.en: She grew up in a small midwestern town.
examples.zh: 她在美国中西部的一个小镇长大。

examples.en: The pilot reviewed his checklist before takeoff.
examples.zh: 飞行员在起飞前检查了他的清单。

examples.en: Her first job was an important milestone in her life.
examples.zh: 她的第一份工作是她人生中一个重要的里程碑。

examples.en: The school had to curtail its sports programs.
examples.zh: 学校不得不削减它的体育项目。

examples.en: Several small states joined to form a federation.
examples.zh: 几个小国联合起来组成了一个联邦。

examples.en: Heavy rain may hamper our travel plans.
examples.zh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们的出行计划。

examples.en: The sun will reappear after the storm passes.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后太阳会再次出现。

examples.en: He is proud of his long family lineage.
examples.zh: 他为自己悠久的家族血统感到自豪。

examples.en: Beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet.
examples.zh: Beta 是希腊字母表的第二个字母。

examples.en: Their family motto is "never give up".
examples.zh: 他们家的座右铭是"永不放弃"。

examples.en: She drinks herbal tea before going to bed.
examples.zh: 她睡前会喝草药茶。

examples.en: My brother is a vegetarian and eats no meat.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是素食者，不吃肉。

examples.en: The garden was full of fragrant roses.
examples.zh: 花园里满是芬芳的玫瑰。

examples.en: The hotel hosted a grand banquet for the guests.
examples.zh: 酒店为宾客举办了一场盛大的宴会。

examples.en: The young singer has a phenomenal voice.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的歌手有一副惊人的好嗓子。

examples.en: He poured rich gravy over the roast potatoes.
examples.zh: 他把浓郁的肉汁浇在烤土豆上。

examples.en: The dancer kept her equilibrium on one foot.
examples.zh: 舞者单脚站立保持着平衡。

examples.en: They stayed in a luxurious hotel by the sea.
examples.zh: 他们住在海边一家豪华的酒店里。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to ratify the treaty.
examples.zh: 两国同意批准这项条约。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible.
examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味让人无法抗拒。

examples.en: The old dog slept peacefully by the fire.
examples.zh: 那只老狗在火炉边安详地睡着。

examples.en: The brave fireman saved the trapped child.
examples.zh: 勇敢的消防员救出了被困的孩子。

examples.en: He grew up in a comfortable bourgeois family.
examples.zh: 他在一个舒适的中产阶级家庭中长大。

examples.en: We watched a baseball game at the ballpark.
examples.zh: 我们在棒球场看了一场棒球赛。

examples.en: The movie star was famous for her glamor.
examples.zh: 这位影星以她的魅力而闻名。

examples.en: The river water looked dark and murky.
examples.zh: 河水看上去又暗又浑浊。

examples.en: She added some rosemary to the roast chicken.
examples.zh: 她在烤鸡里加了一些迷迭香。

examples.en: The war caused great upheaval in the country.
examples.zh: 战争给这个国家带来了巨大的动荡。

examples.en: I inadvertently deleted the wrong file.
examples.zh: 我不小心删错了文件。

examples.en: The long illness affected her psychologically.
examples.zh: 长期的疾病在心理上影响了她。

examples.en: Many people once died of tuberculosis.
examples.zh: 曾经有许多人死于肺结核。

examples.en: The office has bright fluorescent lights.
examples.zh: 办公室里装着明亮的荧光灯。

examples.en: Hot lava flowed slowly down the volcano.
examples.zh: 炽热的熔岩沿着火山缓缓流下。

examples.en: We shared a sweet, fresh pineapple on the beach.
examples.zh: 我们在沙滩上分享了一个又甜又新鲜的菠萝。

examples.zh: 一位调停者帮助双方达成了协议。

examples.en: He gave his mother a bouquet of flowers.
examples.zh: 他送给妈妈一束鲜花。

examples.zh: 这些牛接受了炭疽病的检测。

examples.en: The baby grows in its mother's womb.
examples.zh: 婴儿在母亲的子宫里成长。

examples.en: The company cares about the sustainability of its products.
examples.zh: 这家公司关注其产品的可持续性。

examples.en: She hired a tutor to help with her math.
examples.zh: 她请了一位家庭教师来辅导她的数学。

examples.en: The teacher wrote the answer on the board with chalk.
examples.zh: 老师用粉笔把答案写在黑板上。

examples.zh: 他正处于事业的十字路口。

examples.zh: 这个小村庄是另一个国家境内的一块飞地。

examples.zh: 地震导致许多家庭被迫迁移。

examples.en: They made a long trek across the desert.
examples.zh: 他们徒步跋涉穿越了沙漠。

examples.en: The leftist party promised more help for workers.
examples.zh: 左派政党承诺为工人提供更多帮助。

examples.en: The old furnace kept the whole house warm.
examples.zh: 这台旧火炉让整栋房子都暖和起来。

examples.en: Artists mix pigment with oil to make paint.
examples.zh: 画家把颜料与油混合来制作油漆。

examples.en: She understood every nuance of his words.
examples.zh: 她理解他话语中的每一个细微差别。

examples.en: He bought a clever gadget for opening cans.
examples.zh: 他买了一个巧妙的开罐头小工具。

examples.en: The actor performed a dangerous stunt himself.
examples.zh: 这位演员亲自完成了一个危险的特技。

examples.en: He finally got help to fight his alcoholism.
examples.zh: 他终于得到了帮助来对抗他的酗酒问题。

examples.en: She spent her money wisely and saved a lot.
examples.zh: 她明智地花钱，存下了很多。

examples.en: The new app is simple and intuitive to use.
examples.zh: 这款新应用使用起来简单又直观。

examples.en: Doctors worked hard to eradicate the disease.
examples.zh: 医生们努力消灭这种疾病。

examples.en: The diver took beautiful underwater photos.
examples.zh: 潜水员拍了一些美丽的水下照片。

examples.en: He took a second job to augment his income.
examples.zh: 他找了第二份工作来增加收入。

examples.en: He tried to shun trouble by staying quiet.
examples.zh: 他想保持安静以避开麻烦。

examples.en: The ancient fortress stood high on the hill.
examples.zh: 那座古老的城堡高高地矗立在山上。
